summary: This bill establishes an American Workforce Program within the Department of Commerce to provide workforce education subsidies to employers who offer paid, full-time, on-the-job training and educational instruction to individuals without a bachelor's degree, as an alternative to traditional college education.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes an American Workforce Program that provides an alternative to college through paid, full-time positions combining on-the-job work and educational training. While it allows unions to be third-party training entities, the overall focus is on employer-led contracts and subsidies, with provisions like not making employers subject to OFCCP jurisdiction as federal contractors, which generally favors employer flexibility over increased union power or labor regulations.
